### Available skills
- imagegen: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas. (file: r0/imagegen/SKILL.md)
- openai-docs: Use for Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, customization, automations, and self-knowledge—including 'you,' 'your,' 'this app,' or 'this coding agent' when they refer to Codex—and for OpenAI APIs/products and ChatGPT Work. Also use for model choice/migration, prompting, SDKs, Responses, Realtime, agents, evals, and Chat/Work/Codex comparisons. Do not use for generic app/software tasks that merely mention Codex. (file: r0/openai-docs/SKILL.md)
- skill-creator: Create or update a Codex skill with appropriately scoped instructions and any needed supporting resources. (file: r0/skill-creator/SKILL.md)
- skill-installer: Install Codex skills into $CODEX_HOME/skills from a curated list or a GitHub repo path. Use when a user asks to list installable skills, install a curated skill, or install a skill from another repo (including private repos). (file: r0/skill-installer/SKILL.md)
- app-69b184a609e881919dea5be720cd7933:boundary-setting-rehearsal: Rehearse stating a boundary, responding to pushback, and closing clearly with the Conversation app. Use when the user wants to practise saying no, protecting time or responsibilities, or holding a personal or workplace limit under pressure. Add a structured boundary drill and reusable wording rather than merely opening generic role-play. Do not turn a fixed boundary into an unwanted negotiation or open a widget for advice-only requests. (file: r3/boundary-setting-rehearsal/SKILL.md)
- app-69b184a609e881919dea5be720cd7933:conversation-debrief-and-retry: Review a Conversation app rehearsal and turn one observed difficulty into a focused retry. Use when the user asks to debrief, review their selected replies, replay a difficult moment, or practise an improvement after a session. Ground feedback in visible conversation context and submitted responses; do not invent a transcript or rewind widget state. Give a review without opening a new rehearsal unless the user asks to retry. (file: r3/conversation-debrief-and-retry/SKILL.md)
- app-69b184a609e881919dea5be720cd7933:interview-answer-rehearsal: Practise behavioural interview answers and probing follow-up questions with the Conversation app. Use when the user wants a mock interview, help making an answer specific, or a rehearsal using situation, task, action, and result. Ground answers in the user's real examples and produce an improved answer outline. Do not invent accomplishments, employer requirements, or an interviewer's private evaluation; keep advice-only requests in chat. (file: r3/interview-answer-rehearsal/SKILL.md)
- app-69b184a609e881919dea5be720cd7933:negotiation-rehearsal: Rehearse a proposal, objections, and conditional concessions with the Conversation app. Use when the user wants to practise negotiating a start date, workload, compensation conversation, deadline, or another agreement. Establish the user's desired outcome, fallback, and voluntary concessions, then produce a proposal and concession plan. Keep this as communication practice using user-supplied facts rather than market, legal, or financial advice. (file: r3/negotiation-rehearsal/SKILL.md)
- app-69b184a609e881919dea5be720cd7933:repair-conversation-rehearsal: Practise an apology, listening to the other person's reaction, and offering concrete repair with the Conversation app. Use when the user wants to rehearse apologising, taking responsibility, or repairing a personal or workplace misunderstanding without becoming defensive. Ground the apology in the user's account and responsibility; do not assign blame, invent feelings, promise forgiveness, or open a widget for wording advice alone. (file: r3/repair-conversation-rehearsal/SKILL.md)
- app-69b184a609e881919dea5be720cd7933:response-strategy-walkthrough: Explain the tradeoffs among the current Conversation app reply choices while leaving the decision to the user. Use when the user asks to compare options, understand how a reply may land, or draft an alternative before submitting a response. Reuse visible continuation tool inputs and the user's goal. Do not choose, submit, edit widget state, or advance the role-play merely to provide coaching; request the option text if it is unavailable. (file: r3/response-strategy-walkthrough/SKILL.md)
- app-69b184a609e881919dea5be720cd7933:second-language-conversation-practice: Practise a second language through a graded text conversation in the Conversation app. Use when the user wants a language role-play, everyday conversation rehearsal, or progressively less help with replies at a chosen proficiency level. Establish a target language, situation, and feedback preference, then review submitted wording and provide reusable phrases. Do not claim audio, pronunciation assessment, formal proficiency certification, or access to unseen drafts. (file: r3/second-language-conversation-practice/SKILL.md)

The default command desk for BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP and ZEC. (file: r1/crypto-futures-desk/SKILL.md)
- cr-quant-desk:market-regime-intelligence: Use for crypto or financial macro/micro market analysis, explanations of a rally or selloff, session opening risk, liquidity sweeps, cross-asset signals, derivatives flows or a request to cross-check multiple sources. (file: r1/market-regime-intelligence/SKILL.md)

- cr-quant-desk:trade-review-and-calibration: Use when reviewing previous crypto predictions, assessing whether long/short odds were accurate, analyzing past trades, designing a trading journal, backtesting small-move scalps, or refining a market model from performance. (file: r1/trade-review-and-calibration/SKILL.md)

(file: r6/update-plugin/SKILL.md)

## Replay

Run `npm run --silent replay -- PATH` with a version 1 replay JSON file. Valid input prints only its final version 1 snapshot JSON to stdout and exits 0. Invalid input prints nothing to stdout, writes a message to stderr and exits nonzero. The command's silent flag suppresses its npm banner so stdout stays JSON.
